newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ ends sharply firmer, market reversal glimpsed.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ ends sharply firmer, market reversal glimpsed.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures ended sharply higher, piercing key technical indicators but some traders remained cautious about heralding a key reversal formation in the market.
Monday was the first delivery date for the March contract and 661 lots were delivered.
"That's fairly heavy and there is no sign of tightness in that," Bernard Savaiko of PaineWebber said.
A broker said Monday's dealings looked like a reversal formation in the market. Heavy delivery notices spurred initial trade selling which lured speculators in to buy.
The market then pierced the four and nine day moving averages, but failed to break through the 18 day average.
"I am waiting one more day to see if the market moves upwards before saying this is a reversal in the market," the broker added.
May FCOJ settled 2.70 cents firmer at 81.80 cents per pound, traded 82.40 to 78.30 cents. Spot March went out 2.60 cents higher at 79.00 cents.
Volume was estimated at 4,200 lots compared to Friday's official 6,500 lots.
Traders said the planned strike on March 5 at Brazil's Parangua port played no major role behind Monday's higher juice prices even though the country is an exporter of the commodity.
